description: This is the main activity class (MainActivity.java) for an Android application that implements search functionality via the action bar. It handles search intents, manages loader callbacks for querying contacts, and sets up the search view in the options menu.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity class for an Android app enabling contact search via the action bar.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the content view, and handles incoming intents.

methods.name: onNewIntent
methods.description: Handles new intents received while the activity is running.

methods.name: handleIntent
methods.description: Processes incoming search intents, retrieves the search query, and initiates contact loader callbacks.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Sets up the options menu, inflates menu items, and configures the SearchView with the SearchManager.
